prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1039; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I can tell you I was the driver of the blue sedan involved in the collision.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance when the other vehicle came down the lane.
Q: How fast were you moving when you began to pull out?
A: Maybe a couple of miles an hour. I was backing out slowly. I looked over my shoulder but the other car was already close.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Only at the last second. It was a dark SUV and it didn't seem to be slowing down.
Q: What part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The rear driver's side door and quarter panel. My head hit the window frame when we jolted.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that afternoon. They said I have a concussion. I've had headaches, dizziness, and I'm sensitive to light.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Some of them, yes. My doctor has me resting from screens and I'm not driving much right now.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about how the accident happened?
A: Only that I'm sure the other driver was going too fast for the lot. I've been careful my whole life, and this has really disrupted my work.
Q: Thank you. We will follow up with any documentation you can provide, including your medical records.
A: Okay, I'll get those to you.
